\\\"./process-terminal-payment-webhook\\\";\\n\\nit(\\\"verifies and processes a provider event without a user session\\\", async () => {\\n  const confirmed = { id: \\\"charge\\\", status: ({\\n        refund: vi.fn(),\\n        start: vi.fn(),\\n        verifyWebhook: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ chargeId: \\\"charge\\\", event }),\\n      }),\\n    },\\n  );\\n  await expect(\\n    service.execute({\\n      chargeId: \\\"charge\\\",\\n      organizationId: \\\"organization\\\",\\n      provider: \\\"SANDBOX\\\",\\n      rawBody: \\\"{}\\\",\\n      signature: event: {\\n      eventId: \\\"event-002\\\",\\n      externalId: \\\"external-charge\\\",\\n      feeAmount: \\\"1.0000\\\",\\n      occurredAt: \\\"2026-08-20T12:00:00.000Z\\\",\\n      status: \\\"CONFIRMED\\\" as const,\\n    },\\n  });\\n  const service = new ProcessTerminalPaymentWebhook(\\n    { run: vi.fn(), runSystem },\\n    {\\n      resolve: () => ({\\n        refund: vi.fn(),\\n        start: vi.fn(),\\n        verifyWebhook,\\n      }),\\n    },\\n  );\\n\\n  await expect(\\n    service.execute({\\n      chargeId: \\\"requested-charge\\\",\\n      organizationId: \\\"organization\\\",\\n      provider: \\\"SANDBOX\\\",\\n      rawBody: \\\"{}\\\",\\n      signature: \\\"signature\\\",\\n    }),\\n  ).rejects.toMatchObject({ code:
